intent: Enforce autoload registration allowlists and absolute-path hygiene for GDScript projects, and record the adopted community style tooling.

requirements.REQ-GH-A: The boundary checker rejects a project.godot autoload registration that is missing from the policy allowlist with exit code 1.
requirements.REQ-GH-B: The boundary checker rejects absolute filesystem paths in GDScript outside tests while res:// and user:// paths pass.
